$schema_note: Selection thresholds for the derived blocks of dataset.json (plan T9a). Reverse-engineered from the committed dataset: every boundary across all 11 entities and every comparison is consistent with these constants (tests/unit/property-financials-build-dataset.test.ts pins the reproduction). Change here, not in code.

account_movers.$note: properties-level opex account movers (account_movers[id][comparison]): opex accounts whose |current - prior| is at least the threshold for the comparison's period family, sorted by |delta| descending.

drivers.$note: history[id].drv[period]: revenue + opex accounts with |current - prior| >= minAbsDelta (whole dollars), top `max` by |delta|. Yearly keys exist only when both the year and the prior year have 12 months of data; the YTD key is always produced.
